description: Create a new constructor function in the filesystem package that allows creating a File object directly from a byte slice, eliminating the need to write bytes to disk only to read them back. This will simplify workflows where data is already available in memory, particularly for file upload operations from events.
functional_requirements: Implement a NewFileFromBytes function that accepts a byte slice and returns a File object
The returned File object should behave identically to one created from a disk file path
Ensure the function properly handles empty byte slices and nil inputs
Include appropriate error handling for any memory allocation or initialization failures
Add comprehensive unit tests covering normal usage, edge cases, and error conditions
Document the function with clear examples showing its use case for event-driven file uploads
